query: What is Meta's most recently reported number of family daily active people, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Meta’s most recently reported family daily active people (DAP) was 3.64 billion, averaging for September 2026, reported in Meta’s Q3 2026 results press release dated October 21, 2026. [1] Meta’s most recently reported full-time employees figure is not separately provided in the same source; it reports “headcount” (66,775) as of September 30, 2026, in that same Q3 2026 results press release. [1]
